title: Elijah, the Widow, and the Drought

questions.question: What did Elijah tell Ahab would not happen except by his word?
options: There shall be neither dew nor rain
questions.correctAnswer: There shall be neither dew nor rain
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 17:1 (ESV): "...there shall be neither dew nor rain these years, except by my word."

questions.question: How was Elijah fed at the brook Cherith?
options: Ravens brought him bread and meat
questions.correctAnswer: Ravens brought him bread and meat
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 17:6 (ESV): "And the ravens brought him bread and meat in the morning, and bread and meat in the evening..."

questions.question: Where did God send Elijah after the brook dried up?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 17:9 (ESV): "Arise, go to Zarephath, which belongs to Sidon, and dwell there."

questions.question: What miracle happened for the widow of Zarephath?
options: The jar of flour was not spent, neither did the jug of oil become empty
questions.correctAnswer: The jar of flour was not spent, neither did the jug of oil become empty
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 17:16 (ESV): "The jar of flour was not spent, neither did the jug of oil become empty..."

questions.question: What happened to the widow's son?
options: He became sick and stopped breathing
questions.correctAnswer: He became sick and stopped breathing
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 17:17 (ESV): "...the son of the woman... became sick... until there was no breath left in him."

questions.question: How many times did Elijah stretch himself upon the child?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 17:21 (ESV): "Then he stretched himself upon the child three times and cried to the LORD..."

questions.question: What was the widow doing when Elijah met her?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 17:10 (ESV): "...And behold, a widow was there gathering sticks."

questions.question: Where was the brook Cherith located?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 17:3 (ESV): "Depart from here and turn eastward and hide yourself by the brook Cherith, which is east of the Jordan."

questions.question: What did Elijah ask the widow to make first?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 17:13 (ESV): "...but first make me a little cake of it and bring it to me..."

questions.question: What did the woman say when Elijah raised her son?
options: Now I know that you are a man of God, and that the word of the LORD in your mouth is truth
questions.correctAnswer: Now I know that you are a man of God, and that the word of the LORD in your mouth is truth
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 17:24 (ESV): "And the woman said to Elijah, 'Now I know that you are a man of God...'"

questions.question: Who was Elijah known as (his origin)?
options: The Tishbite, of Tishbe in Gilead
questions.correctAnswer: The Tishbite, of Tishbe in Gilead
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 17:1 (ESV): "Now Elijah the Tishbite, of Tishbe in Gilead, said to Ahab..."

questions.question: Why did the widow think Elijah had come?
options: To bring her sin to remembrance and to cause the death of her son
questions.correctAnswer: To bring her sin to remembrance and to cause the death of her son
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 17:18 (ESV): "...You have come to me to bring my sin to remembrance and to cause the death of my son!"

questions.question: Where did Elijah take the boy to pray for him?
options: To the upper chamber where he lodged
questions.correctAnswer: To the upper chamber where he lodged
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 17:19 (ESV): "...and carried him up into the upper chamber where he lodged..."

questions.question: What did Elijah drink at Cherith?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 17:4 (ESV): "You shall drink from the brook..."

questions.question: To which region does Zarephath belong?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 17:9 (ESV): "Arise, go to Zarephath, which belongs to Sidon..."

key_verse_text: And the woman said to Elijah, “Now I know that you are a man of God, and that the word of the LORD in your mouth is truth.” (ESV)
